about: The game's one piece of music (#9, docs/GAME_DESIGN.md §19, docs/music/MUSIC_BRIEF.md): where it came from, under what terms, and how tools/music/cut-loop.py cuts it into the two clips the game plays. The CC0 sounds of play are listed apart, in licences.json.
title: Müze Teması
plays: everywhere: the museum's hall, the map, the collection, the shop and the levels; no other music and no short cues

licence.account: the project owner's Suno Premier account
licence.commercialUse: allowed, per the owner: their Suno Premier subscription allows commercial use of the songs made while it is active, and they already publish their Suno music on their YouTube channel (2026-10-19)
